subject: Update reply schema for LMOVE and BLMOVE (#2541)
reason: The change edits only the reply_schema metadata in lmove.json and blmove.json to document the existing nil reply when the source key is missing. No C code or runtime behaviour changes: LMOVE/BLMOVE reply identically on the parent and the change, so a compared sequence would find no difference and there is nothing to exercise.
